BrochureContent.Content:
Bowe Property presents to the market No. 2 Old Chapel, Bandon, Co. Cork. Located in the heart of Old Chapel, this attractive three-bedroom terraced residence offers the perfect balance of convenience, comfort, and peaceful living. Situated within walking distance of Bandon town and its excellent range of amenities. The property enjoys a highly convenient location while retaining a quiet and welcoming atmosphere. The accommodation offers a lounge with a solid fuel stove connected to a fully fitted kitchen/dining room with three overhead bedrooms, family bathroom and ground floor w.c., with a host of features including fitted kitchen appliances, ceramic tiling, wooden floors, built in robes, oil fired central heating and much much more. The home is presented in a manner that will appeal to first-time buyers, investors and those seeking a comfortable residence in an established and convenient location. A standout feature of the property is its beautifully maintained rear garden. Bright, private, and wonderfully peaceful, this colourful outdoor space offers a rare sense of tranquillity and provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining, gardening enthusiasts or simply relaxing and unwinding. The garden greatly enhances the overall appeal of the home and creates a private retreat to be enjoyed throughout the year. For those seeking a well-located home with spacious accommodation and an exceptional garden setting, this charming property represents an excellent opportunity and a perfect complement to modern living.

Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by prior appointment.

Entrance Hall - 1.37m x 1.36m
Access to living/dining area. Ceramic tiled floor. Recessed coconut mat. Feature wooden paneling. 


Living/Dining - 5.42m x 4.26m
Stairs to overhead accommodation with understairs storage. Access to kitchen. Two windows to front. Solid fuel stove with granite hearth. Wooden floor. Built in display units. Wooden ceiling beams. T.V. and telephone points. Two radiators. 


Kitchen - 3.62m x 3.18m
Fully fitted with presses & cupboards. Appliances include freestanding double electric oven, hob and overhead extractor, fridge/freezer, dishwasher & washing machine. Ceramic tiled floor & splashback. Window to rear gardens. Access to rear lobby. Radiator. 


Rear Lobby - 1.56m x 0.89m
Ceramic tiled floor. Recessed coconut mat. Centre light fixture. Access to rear & guest w.c.. Radiator.


Guest W.C. - 1.21m x 0.87m
Fully fitted with w.c. & wash-hand basin. Ceramic tiled floor & splashback. Centre light fixture. 


Landing (L - Shape) - 2.68m x 2.37m x 0.77m
Access to all bedrooms, family bathroom & airing cupboard. Attic hatch. 


Bedroom 1 - 3.25m x 3.00m
Built in robe. Two windows to front. Feature wooden ceiling paneling. Wooden floor. Radiator. 


Bedroom 2 - 4.25m x 2.26m
Built in robe & desk. Window to front. Feature wooden ceiling paneling. Wooden floor. Radiator.


Bedroom 3 - 3.63m x 2.79m
Built in robe. Window to rear overlooking gardens. Attic hatch. Wooden floor. Radiator.


Family Bathroom - 2.63m x 1.45m
Fully fitted with w.c., wash-hand basin with vanity unit & bathtub with overhead electric Mira shower. Ceramic tiled wall surround. Window to rear gardens. Extractor fan. Radiator.
